_note: All configs: same 92 chunks (Day 6 index B), same questions, user-provided chapter filter applied when the question has one. Context budget in characters (incl. chunk header). Top-3 is always exported for Hit@1 / Evidence Hit@3.

M2_bm25.hypothesis: Questions reuse exact method names (find(), count(), split()); lexical match may rank the defining chunk higher than dense.

M3_hybrid.hypothesis: RRF of dense + BM25 recovers chunks found by only one of them -> higher Evidence Hit@3 than either.

I1_hybrid_rerank.hypothesis: Day 6 errors q15/t01 were ranking errors (right page, wrong chunk first); a cross-encoder reading query+chunk together should raise Hit@1.

I2_neighbors.hypothesis: Day 6 B chunks split one topic across neighbours (Filtering intro 0085 vs syntax 0086, t01 explanation 0003 vs table 0004); adding same-section neighbours raises Context Evidence Rate without changing ranking.

I3_rerank_maxseg.hypothesis: Dev error q03: the gold chunk 0021 is a for-loop quiz with the count() definition only in its last lines (Day 6 chunking flaw); whole-chunk cross-encoder scores are diluted. Scoring 350-char segments and taking the max should keep such chunks in the top-3 without re-indexing.
